notes:
Lead from site signup (chat widget) 2025-01-08. Primary contact: Maya Lin (Head of Product). Wants a small-footprint hosted integration first, then Dedicated if traffic patterns justify.

Key pain: mobile shoppers ask product-specific questions (materials, fit, shipping) and current rules-based FAQ returns wrong answers frequently -> 30% drop-off on product pages. Looking to replace with ML-driven Q&A + catalog enrich to auto-fill attribute gaps (materials, dimensions).

Quote from discovery call: "We need sub-250ms p95 on short Qs for mobile or it feels sluggish — but cost can't balloon."

Preferences discussed: open models acceptable, prefer ability to pick cheaper fallback model for non-critical calls; sample preference for smaller Llama-like variants if accuracy comparable. Interested in Redwood suggestions on caching/prefix handling for product SKU queries and automatic fallback routing during spikes.

Security: standard SSO for internal staff, audit logs required for billing/compliance, flagged subset of EU customers require data residency for product images/PII. Procurement will ask for SOC2 evidence before moving to contract.

POC scope: 15k SKU sample, chat widget + search autocomplete endpoing, metrics -> avg latency, p95 latency, hallucination rate on 300 annotated questions, cost per 1k tokens. POC length: 2 weeks.

Internal notes: Maya asked for rough pricing band (monthly) and a simple integration guide. Diego to provision API keys and a sandbox dataset. Send security FAQ and SOC2 one-pager.

Short-term ask: pathways for burst handling (autoscale + burst credits) and any whitepaper on caching + prompt templates for product Q&A.
